instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova Technologies is a regional fiber-optic broadband ISP focused on building and operating FTTH networks in underserved rural and semi-urban areas. Currently serving 35,000 subscribers across 12 municipalities, the company focuses on providing reliable access while managing complex spectrum and infrastructure regulations. The organization operates with a lean structure and prioritizes stability over rapid technological shifts.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is not a formalized function in our organization; efforts are typically isolated, grassroots attempts by team members to test new tools or workflows without formal executive sponsorship or structured measurement. Past actions have been limited to minor service tweaks and technical debt remediation.
answers.strategicGoals: Nova's primary goal is market defense against international competitors by establishing strong local brand loyalty and offering superior, reliable service packages within their current 12-municipality footprint. Secondary goals include improving operational efficiency to sustain profitability while preparing for an IPO-driven growth narrative.
answers.additionalContext: The need to demonstrate innovation-driven growth for an IPO mandates that any new initiatives must be cost-effective and quantifiable. ESG metrics improvement is a secondary driver, focusing on energy efficiency in network operations.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: XGS-PON and IPTV Service Rollout
opportunities.rationale: Upgrading the existing fiber infrastructure to XGS-PON will immediately increase bandwidth capacity, allowing Nova to justify service tier price increases and reduce churn among current customers. This is a low-risk technical upgrade that directly addresses customer demand for better performance.

first_actions: Complete vendor evaluation of XGS-PON compatibility with existing equipment.
Develop a phased deployment plan targeting the highest density nodes first.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Minor CAPEX allocation for optics and activation software
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% increase in average customer service satisfaction score within Q3.
milestones: Q2: Finalize vendor contract and pilot deployment on 500 core lines.
Q4: Full network-wide migration to XGS-PON.

opportunities.title: Localized B2B Private Network Pilot (Defensive Moat)
opportunities.rationale: To counter high competitive pressure, Nova could pilot a highly secure, dedicated private fiber network offering to key local businesses. This service offers guaranteed latency and security features that competitors, focused on residential mass market, cannot easily replicate quickly without massive infrastructure overhaul.

first_actions: Conduct surveys with 5 anchor businesses identifying high-latency pain points.
Engage a specialized security consultant to define the Minimum Viable Private Network (MVP).
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure three signed B2B anchor contracts with a minimum 3-year contract term.
milestones: Q1: Complete MVP design and secure initial funding from the budget pool.
Q3: Launch pilot program serving 5 key clients.

opportunities.title: ESG-Focused Energy Efficiency Program
opportunities.rationale: Implementing smart grid management and optimizing power consumption across the passive infrastructure can reduce operational costs and positively impact ESG reporting, satisfying investor requirements. This is a low-cost process improvement.

first_actions: Audit current network power usage across all 12 municipalities.
Identify 3 high-impact areas for immediate passive cooling optimization.
resources_needed: Internal engineering time (no major capital spend)
Software tools for monitoring and reporting
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a measurable 5% reduction in operational energy consumption within one year.
milestones: Q2: Complete initial audit and baseline measurement.
Q4: Implement efficiency measures across all high-consumption nodes.

next_steps.action: Form a small cross-functional task force to formalize the innovation pipeline and define clear, measurable KPIs for all upcoming initiatives.
Finalize the business case and budget request for the XGS-PON upgrade pilot project to secure mid-year funding.
Conduct market analysis on potential partnership opportunities in adjacent geographic regions to explore radical defense options.

key_weaknesses: Absence of a formal innovation process leading to inconsistent strategic direction.
Extremely limited budget allocation (only 3%) hindering large-scale R&D or market shifts.
Low digital maturity prevents rapid adoption of advanced automation and scalable service models.
Over-reliance on maintaining legacy infrastructure rather than proactive future-proofing.
